newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-More than one-fifth of Queensland in drought.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-More than one-fifth of Queensland in drought.

text.p: More than one-fifth of the Australian state of Queensland remains drought-stricken but forecasters expect good heavy rain between now and March, a Department of Primary Industries spokesman said on Wednesday.
DPI drought and natural disaster unit manager Maurie Doyle said central Queensland and other areas, representing a total of 22 percent of the state by area, were drought stricken.
This compared with 35 percent of the state drought affected a year ago, he said. Rain had improved the situation for some farmers, especially grain growers in the southeast, he said.

"All the indications are that (Queensland) will get above average rain between January and March," he said. "State forecasters are predicting good heavy rain." This could be seen as bringing an end to the drought, he said.
